def add(x, y):
    return (x + y) % mod

def sub(x, y):
    return x - y if x >= y else x - y + mod

def mul(x, y):
    return (x * y) % mod

def get_fac_and_inv(n):
    global fac, inv, invfac
    fac = [1] * (n + 1)
    inv = [1] * (n + 1)
    invfac = [1] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        inv[i] = mul((mod - mod // i), inv[mod % i])
    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        fac[i] = mul(fac[i - 1], i)
        invfac[i] = mul(invfac[i - 1], inv[i])

def C(n, m):
    if n < m or m < 0:
        return 0
    return mul(mul(fac[n], invfac[m]), invfac[n - m])

def P(n, m):
    return C(n + m - 1, m - 1)

    global mod
    n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())
    get_fac_and_inv(500)
    s = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        s[i] = add(s[i - 1], i)

    g = [0] * (n + 1)
    f[0] = 1
    f[1] = 2
    g[0] = 0
    g[1] = 0

            temp = mul(C(i - 1, j), mul(f[j], f[i - 1 - j]))
            f[i] = add(f[i], mul(temp, i + 1))
            g[i] = add(g[i], mul(temp, s[j] + s[i - 1 - j]))
            temp = mul(add(mul(g[j], f[i - 1 - j]), mul(g[i - 1 - j], f[j])), i + 1)
            g[i] = add(g[i], mul(temp, C(i - 1, j)))
    ff = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
    gg = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
    ff[0][0] = 1
    gg[0][0] = 0
    for i in range(m + 1):
        for j in range(m + 1):
            if not ff[i][j]:
                continue
            for k in range(1, m - j + 1):
                ff[i + 1][j + k] = add(ff[i + 1][j + k], mul(mul(ff[i][j], f[k]), C(j + k, k)))
                gg[i + 1][j + k] = add(gg[i + 1][j + k], mul(add(mul(gg[i][j], f[k]), mul(ff[i][j], g[k])), C(j + k, k)))
    ans = 0
    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        if n + 1 - m >= i:
            ans = add(ans, mul(gg[i][m], P(n + 1 - m - i, i + 1)))
    print(ans)
